items.markdown:
`British passport holders can enter Thailand without a visa for up to 60 days for tourism or short business trips` , but must submit the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) within 3 days prior to arrival.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information)[[2]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/travel-to-thailand/travel-to-thailand-from-the-uk)[[3]](https://www.kayak.co.uk/news/visa-for-thailand/)

Entry Requirements & Visa Exemption

- **Stay duration:** Up to 60 days visa-free, which can be extended once locally for an extra 30 days at an immigration office.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements)
- **Passport validity:** Must be valid for at least 6 months from your date of entry.[](https://www.thaiembassy.com/travel-to-thailand/travel-to-thailand-from-the-uk) [[1]](https://cibtvisas.co.uk/thailand-visa)
- **Arrival registration:** The Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) is mandatory for all travelers and must be completed online 3 days before entry.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information) 
- **Onward travel:** You must hold proof of sufficient funds and a confirmed return or onward flight ticket leaving Thailand within the 60-day window.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/exemp-visa) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/exemp-visa)

Applying for a Visa Online

- **Longer or other stays:** If you plan to work, study, or stay longer than the exemption allows, you must apply in advance.
- **Application portal:** All applications must be processed digitally through the official [Thai E-Visa Website](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/).
- **Exceptions:** Holders of UK non-standard travel documents (such as refugee or emergency travel documents) cannot use the visa exemption and must apply for a visa prior to travel.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) 

If you tell me the **purpose of your trip** and **how long you plan to stay** , I can help you figure out if you need a specific e-visa or if the free arrival setup is enough.
